reason: I don't take supplements unless my doctor says so, and nobody has told me I'm low on magnesium. The lab report is nice, but $25 a month for something I don't have a reason to take isn't happening.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other products put several forms in one capsule? And I have no proof I need it at all.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor telling me I'm low on magnesium or recommending this kind of magnesium.
